push.body:
Holy guacamole, Soup_Kitchen22. A 6.9. That's the kind of night that ends up on a refrigerator.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. Selfless as a church potluck, and twice as filling.
+ A new personal record at 6.9. That's growth you can hold.
+ Feeding BellyTb1 like that is a recipe I want to keep making.
+ Fewest missed tackles you've had in 9 matches for us (0). That right there is what good teammates do.
+ Fewest giveaways you've had in 9 matches for us (3). Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.

THE BAD
- 67% passing (6 of 9, up from your usual 61%). From the clipboard: Count your touches. Two-touch is a habit that keeps your head up and the ball moving.
- No shots. A little secret: Attack the box. Near post and far post on every cross and every cutback. Brick by brick.
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 4. Let's not make that a pattern.

Repetition station: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch.

Soup_Kitchen22, here's what I'd tell my own kid: If you're gonna make a mistake, make it at full speed and learn it at half.

You make this job too easy. Don't tell the gaffer. - Coach Lasso

tuxedo_slide, your first match performance of the season with a 6.0. Every oak got rained on once.

+ Most pass accuracy you've had in 23 matches for us (76%). That's the version of you I'm building the team around.

+ Shared the points at 2-2. Tomorrow we take all three.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Let's try: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.
- Shot accuracy 50%, down from your usual 87%. That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. Mark my words: Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
- 4 misplaced passes shaved 0.1 off. Clean that up and you're flying.

! Match rating 6.0, down from your usual 7.7. That one's ugly, friend. No sugar on it.

Kickabout task: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

tuxedo_slide, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: If it was easy, everybody'd be in Division 1.

Mistakes are just lessons in disguise. - Coach Lasso
